fragilesilver

Developer portfolio and software showcase.

Crafting retro handheld utilities, multiplayer educational software, and lightweight developer frameworks.

About Me

Hi, I’m fragilesilver. I build purposeful, bloat-free software for retro gaming handhelds (muOS on Anbernic RG35XX) and real-time interactive web games.

My work focuses on snappy performance, tactile gamepad controls, and clean architecture that respects hardware resources.

Featured Works

muOS Handheld App Suite

A cohesive suite of 5 custom applications built on LÖVE2D and fskit for the Anbernic Allwinner H700 family running muOS Andromeda:

  • ClockMu (v1.0.0) — Alarm clock with repeat schedules, snooze, 15-minute presets, and 8 color themes.
  • JarMu (v1.0.0) — “Shake the jar” weighted random game picker with SD1/SD2 scanning, in-app genre editing, and retro CRT shaders.
  • BatteryMu (v1.0.0) — Live battery monitor with voltage telemetry, battery health analysis, and muOS usage tracking.
  • SwapMu (v1.0.0) — SRAM save swapper bridging Pickle and RetroArch saves with 3-tier safe backup verification.
  • ScrapMu (v0.2.0) — Skyscraper template box art compositing (Retro Dither) with Artie descriptions and a live web dashboard.

All muOS apps are packaged as standalone .muxapp archives. Check out the Installation Guide to learn how to install them via Archive Manager.

CHMS Battleship Royale

A real-time classroom multiplayer battle royale where student crews share one big ocean arena and earn shots by solving Cambridge IGCSE / O Level (0478/2210) pseudocode problems.

  • Tech: JavaScript, Firebase Realtime Database, Canvas.
  • Features: Zero-login QR code join, live teacher dashboard, and spectator projector mode.

fskit — Handheld UI Framework

A modular, high-performance LÖVE2D toolkit providing multi-resolution display management (640×480, 720×480, 720×720), gamepad input abstraction, 10 color themes, and persistent state for muOS.

Craftsmanship Philosophy

  • Lightweight & Bloat-Free: Fast boot times, low memory footprints, and no unnecessary runtime dependencies.
  • Tactile & Joyful Ergonomics: Built around physical console button inputs ([A], [B], [X], [Y], [L1/R1]) and responsive feedback.
  • Independent & Resilient: Self-contained packages that persist settings across reboots and operating system updates.
  • Open Source: Free and open code shared with retro gaming and educational communities.
